Use this (not vox_agy_delegate) when you want the result proven, not asserted.

rows.summary: Execute a skill script in the sandbox (parity with CLI `vox skill run`).

rows.title: Skill Uninstall
rows.summary: Uninstall an installed skill by ID.

rows.title: Skill Use
rows.summary: Load the full SKILL.md body for an installed skill by id or name (tier-2 disclosure).

rows.title: Snapshot Diff
rows.summary: Show the file-level diff between two snapshots.

rows.title: Snapshot List
rows.summary: List recent file snapshots for an agent.

rows.title: Snapshot Restore
rows.summary: Restore files to a previous snapshot state.

rows.title: Spawn Agent
rows.summary: Spawn a new orchestrator agent queue (optional dynamic/transient agent for auto-retire).

rows.title: Speech To Code
rows.summary: Orchestrated speech-to-code: transcribe workspace audio (Oratio) or accept prompt text, then vox_generate_code with shared session_id; optional route_mode, emit_trace_path JSONL for MENS.

rows.title: Submit Task
rows.summary: Submit a new task to the orchestrator. Routes to the best agent by file affinity.

rows.title: Suggest Model
rows.summary: Suggest the best model for a task category string (codegen, review, etc.).

rows.title: Task Status
rows.summary: Get the current status of a specific task by ID.

rows.title: Test All
rows.summary: Run cargo test for the entire workspace.

rows.title: Test Decision
rows.summary: Get the Testing Decision Engine's requirement classification (Required/Recommended/Deferred/Skip) for a task by ID.

rows.title: Tool Search
rows.summary: Search the MCP tool registry by keyword and return matching tools (name, description, input schema) for progressive tool disclosure.

rows.title: Transfer File
rows.summary: Transfer ownership of a file to another agent.

rows.title: Trust Override
rows.summary: Overrides the trust tier for the agent context.

rows.title: Undo
rows.summary: Undo the last operation or a specific operation by ID.

rows.title: Validate File
rows.summary: Validate a .vox file using the full compiler pipeline (lexer → parser → typeck → HIR).

rows.title: Validate Source
rows.summary: Validate Vox source code passed as a string (no filesystem read). Returns LSP-style diagnostics with stable codes and structured autofix suggestions for the iterative AI-assistant repair loop.

rows.title: GUI VUV Validation
rows.summary: Validate Vox/VUV source against the compile-time GUI guarantees (contrast, layer-occlusion, a11y, structural web-IR) without writing files.

rows.title: Verify Task Claims
rows.summary: Check receipt ids an agent claims against the orchestrator's receipt ledger; returns which are valid, fabricated (no ledger entry) or unverified (tag mismatch). Read-only.

rows.title: Visual Rag Query
rows.summary: NOT IMPLEMENTED: multimodal RAG is planned but not wired up; this tool always returns an error. Use vox_search or memory retrieval tools instead.

rows.title: Visus Audit
rows.summary: Performs an automated GUI visual audit (screenshot, AXTree, overlaps).

rows.title: Visus Baseline
rows.summary: Manages golden visual baselines for regression testing.

rows.title: Workspace Create
rows.summary: Create an isolated workspace for an agent.

rows.title: Workspace MCP Refresh
rows.summary: Reloads/refreshes the workspace MCP registry and scan config.

rows.title: Workspace Merge
rows.summary: Merge an agent's workspace changes back to main.

rows.title: Workspace Modules
rows.summary: Returns a list of all .vox files in the workspace repository.

rows.title: Workspace Status
rows.summary: Show files modified in an agent's workspace.
